steps.label: IS_MEMBER()
steps.sub: legacy workspace-level — avoid on UC data

code:
CREATE VIEW sales_redacted AS
SELECT
  user_id,
  CASE WHEN is_account_group_member('auditors')
    THEN email ELSE 'REDACTED'
  END AS email,
  country, product, total
FROM sales_raw
caption: Auditors see the real email; everyone else gets 'REDACTED' — every other column passes through untouched.

code:
CREATE VIEW sales_redacted AS
SELECT user_id, country, product, total
FROM sales_raw
WHERE CASE
    WHEN is_account_group_member('managers') THEN TRUE
    ELSE total <= 1000000
  END;
caption: Only managers see transactions over $1M — the WHERE clause silently filters everyone else's rows.
